designationHistory.name: Sweetwater Marsh National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1988 as Sweetwater Marsh National Wildlife Refuge on the east side of San Diego Bay; combined with the South San Diego Bay Unit (1999) to form San Diego Bay National Wildlife Refuge.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: San Diego Bay National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register, Aug. 18, 2006 (E6-13556), San Diego Bay NWR CCP: "The Sweetwater Marsh Unit was established as a National Wildlife Refuge in 1988"; the South San Diego Bay Unit followed in 1999

review.note: Date 1988 is right for the refuge's oldest unit, which was a separate refuge (Sweetwater Marsh NWR); added the earlier name. Authority not stated in the source.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Sweetwater Marsh Unit Sweetwater Marsh covers 316 acres and was established in 1988 on the east side of San Diego Bay.
